problem_text:
A logistics company is tasked with delivering seven distinct categories of cargo, each of which must pass sequentially through seven specialized handling stages. The revenue generated per ton for each cargo category is listed below:
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 7.013 per ton
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 11.648 per ton
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 15.113 per ton
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 8.36 per ton
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 15.268 per ton
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 17.929 per ton
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 16.359 per ton

The handling duration required per ton for each stage is as follows:
* For Cargo Alpha, Stage 1 requires 0.966 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 1.362 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 1.979 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 1.794 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 0.809 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 1.434 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 0.494 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Beta, Stage 1 requires 1.203 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 0.842 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 0.989 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 0.99 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 1.394 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 1.723 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 1.043 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Gamma, Stage 1 requires 0.464 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 1.557 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 1.553 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 1.917 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 0.909 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 1.035 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 1.173 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Delta, Stage 1 requires 1.806 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 1.468 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 0.238 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 0.573 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 1.737 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 1.254 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 1.773 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Epsilon, Stage 1 requires 0.941 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 0.579 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 0.207 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 1.993 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 0.445 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 1.357 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 1.081 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Zeta, Stage 1 requires 0.884 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 1.167 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 0.341 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 1.946 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 1.087 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 0.228 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 0.955 (ton-hours)
* For Cargo Eta, Stage 1 requires 1.563 (ton-hours), Stage 2 requires 0.762 (ton-hours), Stage 3 requires 1.541 (ton-hours), Stage 4 requires 1.581 (ton-hours), Stage 5 requires 0.63 (ton-hours), Stage 6 requires 1.942 (ton-hours), Stage 7 requires 0.25 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative handling time at Stage 1 must not exceed 241.267 hours
* The cumulative handling time at Stage 2 must not exceed 268.595 hours
* The cumulative handling time at Stage 3 must not exceed 175.935 hours
* The cumulative handling time at Stage 4 must not exceed 394.393 hours
* The cumulative handling time at Stage 5 must not exceed 218.45 hours
* The cumulative handling time at Stage 6 must not exceed 197.432 hours
* The cumulative handling time at Stage 7 must not exceed 198.166 hours

Given the imperative that the total processing duration for each individual stage—Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3, Stage 4, Stage 5, Stage 6, and Stage 7—must remain within its respective available time allocation, determine the optimal tonnage for each cargo category to maximize total revenue.
